Thanks for the context, Jonas — good signal. A few actionable notes: 

1) Contract / compliance
- PHI-adjacent: we should route this to Security for a quick DPA confirmation, but our existing DPA covers de-identified clinical notes. If they need full PHI handling, that gets into Private deployment / Dedicated considerations.
- For standard MSA we can accept with our template, legal review expected but no unusual redlines anticipated.

2) Pricing & commercialization path
- POC (card): offer a time-boxed POC package: $4,500 for 30 days, up to 100k tokens, with standard support.
- Production (PO + MSA): recommend annual commitment pricing tier. Suggest proposal: $X per 1M tokens (use conservative pricing to keep margin) — I'll attach a short pricing band separately in HubSpot. For negotiation: be prepared for sticker reduction for committed volume.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is fine for POC. For PO-based production we should still issue invoices to their AP team; if they want marketplace contracts for production, that requires us to onboard listing and involves a 30-day delay.

3) Approvals mapping
- Economic buyer: Dr. Anil Reddy — will need ROI memo from us (short one-pager).
- Finance sponsor: Maya Singh — her team will own PO issuance and payment terms (Net30 typical).
- Signatory: Legal counsel for MSA; we typically need Director-level approval for commitments >$100k.

Next steps I recommend (internal)
- Jonas: send POC quote (card) + a PO-able SOW for production (line items + invoice flow).
- Marissa: prep ROI one-pager for Dr. Reddy and confirm if a technical whitepaper is helpful as backup.
- I'll prepare the pricing band and note the AWS marketplace timeline.

I can join the next call with their finance/legal if needed.
